title: Shiv Mahima
desc: Shivdas and his wife, devoted to Lord Shiva, live simply in a village. Despite hardships, the lord helps them, guiding and protecting their family always.

title: Jai Dakshineshwar Kali Maa
desc: A young woman, harassed and tormented by her mother-in-law, is rescued by the Goddess Kali who is pleased with her ardent devotion.

title: Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge
desc: Raj and Simran meet in Europe. Simran's family arranges her marriage. Raj, encouraged by his father, follows her to India. He strives to win over her family, including her father, for their blessings.

title: Raja Hindustani
desc: In a heartwarming tale, two lovers from different worlds defy the odds and marry, facing challenges as they pursue happiness together-despite the girl's father's disapproval.

title: Khuddar
desc: An honest man turns to crime to support his family, but guilt and tragedy haunt his journey. Can he redeem himself before it's too late, or will his past forever define his future?

title: Mandi - The Market Place
desc: City politicians target a brothel, rallying morality supporters who push residents away. The madam relocates prostitutes far away, leading to hopeful changes for all.

title: Ishk Actually
desc: Gia's life gets complicated when her former lover, Neil, reappears. Over time, she realizes that true happiness comes from following her heart.
